column2: Power blocs, treaties and the console command reference.
Open the power bloc panel: members, cohesion, identity, map mode.
Open the treaty window: exchange provinces or populations with another country.
Found a bloc led by you, or leave the bloc you are in (the most prestigious member takes over).
Leader only: change the bloc identity (Military, Trade, Empire, Religious). Each has its own monthly effects.
Leader only: dissolve your bloc. Every member leaves.
Colour the political map by bloc (countries outside blocs turn grey).
Exchange provinces or populations with this country. The AI weighs culture, cores, power and relations.
Invite this country into your power bloc (or found one). With yesmen on, the AI accepts.
Offer every province of yours where their people are the majority.
Offer money (each click adds 10,000). Money makes almost any deal acceptable.
Article: their people living in your country go home to them.
Pay for ships, trains and relief: nobody dies on the way (+10 acceptance). Without it about 10% of the people who move die.
Ask for every province of theirs where your people are the majority.
Ask them for money (each click adds 10,000).
Article: your people living in their country come home to you.
While on, every province you click on the map is added to (or removed from) the treaty: yours on the left, theirs on the right.
Add the money they ask for to your side.
Send the treaty. They answer at once. A refusal costs 10 relations.
Treaty news. Click to dismiss, the last ones are listed in the BLOCS tab.
Refuse. See the last line for the consequences.
